top.title: Read the status until idle
top.detail: Confirmed by a second read; waits out a running cycle

top.title: Refuse a protected range
top.detail: From BP1:BP0 (Table 6-4); nothing else is sent

top.title: Release WP
top.detail: GpioSet(WriteProtect, INACTIVE), when the port has it

page.title: WRITE
page.detail: Opcode with A8, address byte, 1 to 8 bytes

page.title: Wait for the write cycle
page.detail: Status every 100 us, up to write_timeout_us

page.title: WEN must be 0 again
page.detail: Still 1: the chip ignored the WRITE

end.title: Park WP
